scope: Evidence-backed same-mountain associations within 2 km; source coordinates remain the actual lookout location. This review does not assert public access or current staffing.

reviewedMatches.note: Lookout Point is the tower on Lookout Mountain north of Spokane, 136 m from the catalog summit. The firsthand illustrated site history explicitly places the current tower on Lookout Mountain after its 1976 move from Mica Peak; FFLA lists this location as Standing. Keep the actual tower coordinates.

Happy Camp Baldy's lookout stands on the mountain's east-southeast shoulder, 501 m from the catalog high point. This archive reproduces a 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description locating the lookout east-southeast of Baldy Mountain's highest point and station BALDY MTN. FFLA confirms the current structure is Standing. Keep the actual tower coordinates.

The USFS Smith River NRA Map and Guide, page 19, includes a firsthand history by Ship Mountain lookout John Dean. It identifies Ship Mountain as the four peaks called the Four Brothers and describes the present two-story lookout built on one of those peaks in 2006. Associate it with the named mountain, 872 m from the catalog high point; the lookout is on another summit of that same mountain. Keep the actual tower coordinates.

The USFS Mount Lemmon and Catalina Highway Recreation Guide maps Lemmon Rock Fire Lookout on Mount Lemmon's south shoulder, reached from the summit day-use area via Mount Lemmon Trail and Lemmon Lookout Trail. It is 910 m from the catalog summit. The USFS historical marker photographed at https://www.hmdb.org/m.asp?m=55554 independently identifies this as a 1928 fire lookout; FFLA lists it as Standing. Keep the actual lookout coordinates.

notLinked.reason: Hold for structure-status review. This is on Escudilla Mountain, but the 2011 Wallow Fire caused structural damage. The official BAER report, pages 7 and 17, calls for fencing the tower until removal or replacement. Later firsthand trip accounts still report a burned-out floor and tower remnants. FFLA's unqualified Standing status alone does not establish a surviving intact lookout. No manual match added.

No clear source ties Call Benchmark to the lookout knoll 1,143 m north. CAL FIRE's May 2022 property-exchange notice confirms a dilapidated lookout tower on its Call Mountain parcel but does not establish the benchmark as the same mountain destination. Proximity and a partial name match are insufficient; no manual match added.
Do not associate Leonard Hill's tower with nearby Hubbard Hill from distance alone. No same-mountain evidence supports this link.
Do not associate Fairview Peak's tower with neighboring Bohemia Mountain.
Do not associate Rondaxe/Bald Mountain's tower with nearby Sugarloaf Mountain.
No evidence establishes the lookout on La Mosca as a lookout on the separate Mount Taylor summit destination. Distance alone does not support a link.
Do not associate Signal Peak's tower with neighboring Pinal Peak.
